need: I'm planning my first trip to Xi'an
title: First time in Xi'an

guess.line: My guess: 3 days, a bus tour, lots of noodles

items.name: Hotel 3 nights
items.spec: Mid-range hotel inside the city wall, near the Bell Tower

items.name: Terracotta tour
items.spec: Group day tour, with a 'factory visit' on the way

items.name: Tickets
items.spec: Terracotta Army, City Wall, Bell & Drum Towers

items.name: Food
items.spec: 3 days of noodles, paomo and skewers

beats.say: Xi'an North Station. The map says: city center, 12 km.
Twelve kilometers? I thought the station was IN the city.
Metro Line 2, 27 minutes. Welcome to the start of the Silk Road!
In 629 a monk left this city with a travel pass. You get one too.
Every good day earns a stamp. Fill it, and your plan is ready.

options.label: The Terracotta Army
options.fact: Main draw: the Terracotta Army

reply.say: Eight thousand soldiers and not one of them will move. My kind of crowd.

options.label: Noodles. So many noodles
options.fact: Main draw: Xi'an food — noodles, paomo, the Muslim Quarter

reply.say: Correct answer. We'll schedule history between meals.

options.label: Mountains & views
options.fact: Main draw: nature, especially Mount Hua

reply.say: Please tell me mountains come with elevators.

options.label: Ancient capital vibes
options.fact: Main draw: ancient-capital history and atmosphere — walls, pagodas, the Silk Road

reply.say: Thirteen dynasties ruled from here. You picked well.
Writing that on page one of your pass.

options.label: Just me
options.fact: Traveling solo

reply.say: And me. I'm basically luggage with opinions.

options.label: Me and my partner
options.fact: Traveling as a couple

reply.say: Tandem bikes on the wall. You'll see.

options.label: Family with kids
options.fact: Traveling with children

reply.say: Kids love it: 8,000 faces, all different. Spot-the-difference!

options.label: My parents
options.fact: Traveling with older parents

reply.say: Then we plan for knees, not for Instagram.

options.label: We can hike all day
options.fact: Group is fit; long walks and stairs are fine

reply.say: Speak for yourself.

options.label: Walking's fine, hiking no
options.fact: Comfortable walking, but no long hikes

options.label: Someone's knees complain
options.fact: Someone can't walk far or climb many stairs

reply.say: Got it. Flat routes, short walks, more sitting with a view.

options.label: 2 days
options.fact: 2 days in Xi'an — Terracotta plus the old city

options.label: 3 days
options.fact: 3 days in Xi'an

options.label: 4–5 days
options.fact: 4–5 days in Xi'an — room for Mount Hua or a slow day

options.label: Spring
options.fact: Traveling in spring (Apr–May is mild; crowds spike around May Day)

options.label: Summer
options.fact: Traveling in summer (hot; Mount Hua often foggy Jul–Aug)

options.label: Early October
options.fact: Traveling in early October, around the National Day holiday (1–7 Oct)

options.label: Nov – March
options.fact: Traveling Nov–Mar (cold, quiet; Shaanxi History Museum closed Mondays after 14 Nov)

beats.say: Xi'an Railway Station square, 8 AM. Someone in a uniform waves at you.
Terracotta! Official bus! Very official! I have a lanyard!
He has a lanyard. That's basically a government ID.
Small stop at a jade factory. Also official. Very educational.
Young man. The real bus 306 leaves from Xi'an East Station now.
This one goes to a jade shop. The soldiers are 40 km the other way.

beats.q: So how do you get to the warriors?

options.label: Metro + bus 306
options.fact: Will take the metro to Fangzhicheng hub, then public bus 306 (Tourism Line 5); pay the conductor on board, no transit cards

reply.say: A few yuan and a window seat. Locals' way.

options.label: Didi, door to door
options.fact: Will take Didi to the North Gate (¥120–180 each way)

add.name: Rides
add.spec: Didi to the Terracotta Army and back, plus metro

reply.say: Air conditioning and zero jade. Worth it.

options.label: A guide with a car
options.fact: Wants a private guide with a car for the Terracotta day (handles tickets, transport and the stories)

add.name: Guide + car
add.spec: Private guide and car for the Terracotta day (estimate)

reply.say: Good guides know which soldier has a sense of humor.

options.label: Trust the lanyard
options.fact: Would get on an unofficial tour bus from a street tout

reply.say: Update: I now own a jade dragon. The warriors remain unseen.

beats.say: You spotted the fake bus. First stamp: 🔍 Sharp Eyes.

options.label: Book on WeChat
options.fact: Will book real-name tickets in the official WeChat account 秦始皇帝陵博物院 with a passport, 3–7 days ahead (up to 10 days for holidays)
options.tip: No ticket windows on site. Book early.

options.label: Guide books it
options.fact: Wants a guide to handle the Terracotta booking

add.name: Guide + car
add.spec: Private guide and car for the Terracotta day (estimate)

gamble.label: At the gate
gamble.fact: Plans to buy Terracotta tickets on arrival
gamble.crash: There's no ticket window. Only regret.

beats.say: You step into Pit No. 1. Six thousand soldiers stand in formation.
…oh. Oh wow.
Look closer. Every face is different. Every single one.
That one looks like me before coffee.
2,200 years on guard duty. Respect the commute.

beats.q: How long do you want here?

options.label: One hour, best photos
options.fact: Wants a quick visit focused on the highlights

reply.say: Efficient. The soldiers would approve.

options.label: 3–4 hours, the full story
options.fact: Wants 3–4 hours with an audio guide or guide, all three pits and the museum

reply.say: Then pack snacks. It's a big army.

options.label: A guide with gossip
options.fact: Wants a human guide for the stories behind the warriors

reply.say: Ask about the kneeling archer. Long story.

beats.say: Inside it's 3–4 hours on your feet. We'll plan a rest after.
Stamp two: 🏺 Met the Army.
You again! Skewers! Twenty yuan! Famous since this morning!
Twenty for one skewer? Is the lamb also official?

options.label: I'm hungry. Buy.
options.fact: Would pay main-street tourist prices for convenience

reply.say: Excellent! Also, jade dragon? No? Okay.

options.label: Let's look around
options.fact: Prefers to explore side lanes for better value

reply.say: Fine. But the side lanes have no lanyards.

beats.say: One lane west: Xiyangshi. Half the price, twice the taste.

options.label: I eat everything
options.fact: No dietary restrictions

reply.say: Dangerous words in this street.

options.label: I eat halal
options.fact: Eats halal — the Muslim Quarter is all halal; outside it, roujiamo is often pork and cooking wine is common

reply.say: Every stall here is halal. Outside the Quarter, look for 清真 signs.

options.label: Vegetarian
options.fact: Vegetarian — this street is lamb-heavy; biangbiang noodles and liangpi work if toppings are checked

reply.say: This street is mostly lamb. Noodles are your friend.

options.label: Not too spicy
options.fact: Avoids spicy food; ask for 少辣 (less chili)

reply.say: Say 'shǎo là'. Less chili. They'll still add some.

gift.label: Lane map
gift.fact: Eats in Xiyangshi and Dapiyuan side lanes instead of the main strip
gift.say: Side lanes. Tell them Wang sent you.

beats.say: Paomo! You tear the bread, I add the lamb soup.
Smaller. Smaller! Pea-sized. Like a monk with patience.
No meat? Biangbiang noodles. 58 strokes to write, zero to eat.

beats.q: Tear it yourself, or let me cut it?

options.label: I'll tear like a monk
options.fact: Enjoys slow, hands-on local experiences

reply.say: Twenty minutes. Perfect. Now you're from Xi'an.

options.label: Machine, please
options.fact: Prefers efficiency over ritual

reply.say: Tourist. But a hungry one. Fine.

beats.say: Best thing I've eaten this year. Don't tell my mother.

yes.label: Love them
yes.fact: Comfortable with heights and exposed cliff paths

cards.say: Cycle the city wall: 13.7 km, about 2 hours, ¥45 for 3 hours.

left.label: Walk a bit
left.fact: Would walk a section of the City Wall

right.label: Ride the loop
right.fact: Wants to cycle the full City Wall loop (13.7 km, 1.5–2 h)

cards.say: No bikes for under 12 or over 65. Walk a section and catch the sunset?

left.label: Rest instead
left.fact: Would skip the City Wall to rest

right.label: Sunset stroll
right.fact: A short walk on the City Wall at sunset (bike rental not allowed under 12 / over 65)

cards.say: History Museum: free. Tickets drop 5 days ahead, 17:00. Gone in minutes.

left.label: Skip it
left.fact: Will skip the Shaanxi History Museum

right.label: Set an alarm
right.fact: Will try to book Shaanxi History Museum (free; real-name via WeChat, 5 days ahead at 17:00)

cards.say: Wild Goose Pagoda: temple ¥40, climbing it ¥25 more. Seven floors.

left.label: Just look
left.fact: Will see the pagoda from the free squares

right.label: Climb it
right.fact: Will enter Da Ci'en Temple and climb the pagoda (¥40 + ¥25)

cards.say: The pagoda squares are free and flat. Fountain show at night, free too.

left.label: Hotel nap
left.fact: Would rather rest in the evening

right.label: Fountain night
right.fact: Will see the Big Wild Goose Pagoda squares and fountain (free, flat)

cards.say: Tonight: free neon street, 50,000 people. Or a lake show from ¥199.

left.label: Neon party
left.fact: Wants Datang Everbright City at night (free, very crowded)

right.label: The lake show
right.fact: Wants to see the Song of Everlasting Sorrow at Huaqing Palace (from ¥199; times change with the season)

beats.say: Everyone online says Mount Hua. Should we?
8 to 11 hours of stone stairs. The knees have voted: no.
Skipped for you — I'll note why. We'll add a slow morning instead.
A slow morning. My favorite mountain.

options.label: Cable cars
options.fact: Mount Hua day trip: early HSR, West Peak cable car up, North Peak down (entry ¥160 + cable cars and shuttles; about ¥450–530 all-in with trains)

add.name: Mount Hua day
add.spec: HSR, entry, two cable cars + shuttles (estimate)

options.tip: Up West Peak, down North Peak

options.label: Stay in town
options.fact: Skips Mount Hua and spends the day in Xi'an

gamble.label: Plank walk!
gamble.fact: Wants to try the Changkong plank walk on Mount Hua (harness ~¥30)
gamble.crash: Jay froze on the plank. 40 minutes.

options.label: Shift dates
options.fact: Will move the trip to late September or after 8 October
options.tip: Same weather, a fraction of the crowd

options.label: Book early
options.fact: Keeps National Day dates; books Terracotta about 10 days ahead and everything else the day it opens

gamble.label: It'll be fine
gamble.fact: Keeps National Day dates with no special planning

options.label: Slow & cozy
options.fact: Prefers 1–2 things a day with long breaks

options.label: Pack it in
options.fact: Wants to see as much as possible each day

options.label: Eat-a-thon
options.fact: Wants days built around food, with sights in between

add.name: Food crawl
add.spec: Meals plus a guided Muslim Quarter food walk (estimate)

rounds.q: How do you want to do it?

options.label: DIY with apps
options.fact: Plans and books everything themselves

options.label: DIY + a guide
options.fact: Independent, with a private guide and car for the Terracotta day

options.label: Guided trip
options.fact: Wants a private guide or driver for most days

options.label: Group tours
options.fact: Prefers group day tours (check they don't include shopping stops)

probe.say: Fifteen years guiding here. A few questions, then your pass is full.

options.label: No, just breaks
options.fact: Needs regular breaks, no special equipment

options.label: Wheelchair
options.fact: Needs wheelchair-accessible routes

options.label: Stroller
options.fact: Bringing a stroller

options.label: Exact dates
options.fact: Has exact travel dates

options.label: Just the month
options.fact: Knows the month, not the dates

options.label: Not yet
options.fact: No dates yet

probe.q: What would you hate to miss?

reply.say: Then that goes first in your plan.

probe.say: Last stamp: 📜 Ready for the Silk Road. Your pass is full!

bring.label: Passport country
bring.fact: Passport nationality — to check visa-free entry or 240-hour transit (Xianyang Airport is an eligible port)

bring.label: WeChat account
bring.fact: A WeChat account: Terracotta Army and Shaanxi History Museum are booked in their official WeChat accounts

bring.label: Card for Alipay
bring.fact: A Visa/Mastercard linked to Alipay or WeChat Pay

bring.label: Travel dates
bring.fact: Exact dates, to book the Terracotta Army 3–7 days ahead (10 for holidays)

bring.label: Before / after
bring.fact: Where they come from and go next (e.g. Beijing, Chengdu), to plan trains

secret: Bus 306 to the warriors now leaves from Xi'an East Station. 'Official' buses elsewhere are touts.
